Description: Infection occurs when a susceptible individual comes into contact with an infectious individual.
Progression from the first stage of exposure to the second stage.
Progression from the second stage of exposure to the first stage of being infectious.
Progression from the first stage of being infectious to the second stage.

Name: β
Description: Transmission rate, the rate at which new infections occur given contact.

Name: σ
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious.

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery or removal from the infectious state.

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection.

Name: μ_ICU|E
Description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: σ2_ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission.
